origin: Visual estimate by an AI agent (Claude) on 2x zoomed crops with a 20 px grid. Not confirmed by the owner. Not a detector output.

nose.note: Profile face. Nose tip on the face outline.

r_ear.note: Near ear, center of the ear shell.

neck.note: Midpoint of the two shoulder marks, as the rig defines the neck keypoint.

r_shoulder.note: Jacket shoulder hides the joint. Estimated from the shoulder outline.

l_shoulder.note: Far shoulder, partly hidden by the torso and the jacket.

r_elbow.note: Inside the jacket sleeve. Estimated from the sleeve outline.

l_elbow.note: Far arm inside the sleeve. Estimated from the sleeve outline.

r_wrist.note: Where the hand comes out of the cuff.

l_wrist.note: Where the far hand comes out of the cuff.

r_hip.note: Jeans hide the pelvis. Estimated from the leg axis and the crotch line.

l_hip.note: Jeans hide the pelvis. Estimated from the leg axis and the crotch line.

r_knee.note: Rolled trouser cuff covers the knee.

l_knee.note: Rolled trouser cuff covers the knee.

r_ankle.note: Inside a heeled boot. Estimated from the boot shaft and the sole.

l_ankle.note: Inside a heeled boot. Estimated from the boot shaft and the sole.

unmeasurable.l_eye: Far eye is hidden: the face is in near profile.
unmeasurable.l_ear: Far ear is hidden, as in the rig.
